metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: An intense, prestige crime drama that echoes the bleak tone and high-stakes tension found in Sicario.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: A prestige horror film with deep emotional complexity and unsettling themes, perfect for fans of The Others and The Conjuring 2.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: A demanding character study with a powerhouse performance, matching the serious tone of The Master.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: A methodical and obsessive mystery-thriller that fits your interest in high-quality, atmospheric crime dramas like Gone Girl.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A high-concept, talk-heavy psychological thriller that mirrors the contained tension of Exam and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An atmospheric, prestige horror film that demands attention and offers a dark, historical setting similar to The Others.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: A dark comedy-drama from the director of In Bruges, focusing on complex interpersonal dynamics and emotional weight.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: A masterfully crafted dark comedy and thriller that offers high stakes and biting social commentary.

metas.name: Whiplash
metas.description: An incredibly intense drama about obsession and pressure that matches the pacing and stress of The Hurt Locker.

metas.name: Ex Machina
metas.description: An intellectual sci-fi thriller exploring AI and ethics, making it a perfect companion to The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A definitive dark crime thriller with high stakes and a bleak atmosphere that aligns with your interest in gritty cinema.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: A modern horror standout with a unique premise and high emotional stakes, similar in intensity to Smile 2.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A somber and gritty crime thriller written by the creator of Sicario, focusing on emotional complexity and mystery.
